import math

# Calculate 64 factorial
factorial_64 = math.factorial(64)

# Convert to string to access individual digits
factorial_str = str(factorial_64)

# Sum all the decimal digits using a different iteration method
digit_sum = 0
for digit_char in factorial_str:
    digit_sum += int(digit_char)

print(f"ANSWER: {digit_sum}")
